evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep: 'Can I have your name?' Customer: 'Mary champagne.' Rep later: 'So just to confirm Mary you want to do this October 29th Thursday' — name asked and used.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote offered before moving into details.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep immediately moved into logistics (date, address, square footage) without probing for concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns raised during the call, so this is N/A per rubric.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns raised, so this is N/A per rubric.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Neither the On-Time Guarantee nor No Worries Damage Coverage were mentioned at any point in the call.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep never asked 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent, because no promises were delivered.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Rep did not ask 'What items in this move are you most concerned about?' Instead, rep jumped directly to logistics: 'just to confirm Mary you want to do this October 29th Thursday.' However, the customer volunteered concerns about antique pieces and heavy items early on ('older, like, historical pieces'), which the rep acknowledged passively but never probed deeper into.
evidence_quotes.logistics_gathered: Rep gathered: date (October 29th), partial move nature, address (1404 West Avenue), detached garage destination, elevator and stairs, 4200 sq ft location, some heavy/antique items. Missing: walking distance at both ends, floor count in detail, number of rooms being moved from/to, additional stops, specific room-by-room breakdown. Partial but missing several detail items that would affect estimate accuracy.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Neither packing nor box count were asked. Rep did not ask if customer wanted packing services or estimate a box count for the move.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Rep did not discuss value days, cheaper day options, or date flexibility for pricing savings. This is not applicable because the call routed to walkthrough before any estimate was presented.
evidence_quotes.prep_and_temperature_check: Never given. No prep framing about how preparation affects move duration, and no 'How do you feel about that?' temperature check.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asked 'Did you have any questions. Just let me know' at the very end, which is a throwaway catch-all phrasing, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' concern check.
evidence_quotes.catchall_asked: Rep asked a generic questions-based catch-all ('Did you have any questions') rather than a concerns-based one.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never applicable; call routed to walkthrough before pricing discussion occurred.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Walkthrough scheduled: Sunday the 18th at 10:00 AM. Rep confirmed the virtual walkthrough link would be texted and general pricing emailed. Date and time confirmed. Phone number not confirmed during call. No crew size or arrival window discussed (not applicable for a walkthrough call). No booking for the actual move service occurred on this call.

top_strength: Rep cleanly identified that a 4200 sq ft partial move with antiques warranted a virtual walkthrough and successfully scheduled it with confirmed date, time, and next steps, avoiding an inaccurate estimate.
coaching_note: On walkthrough routes, gather the Two Concerns question and both promises before pivoting to the walkthrough — this call skipped concerns entirely and delivered zero promises, missing an opportunity to build trust with Mary before the video call.
